_comment: Copy this to eas.json and fill in your own values. eas.json is gitignored
because the submit block holds identifiers tied to your Apple account.
production                - EAS manages your signing credentials for you.
production-local-signing  - you supply your own .p12 and provisioning
Delete this profile if you do not need it.
Submit values: ascAppId is the numeric id in your App Store Connect URL,
appleTeamId is the 10-character team id, and the ascApiKey* fields point at
an App Store Connect API key you generate under Users and Access.
